rationale: Agent fails to provide clear ownership, timeline, or actionable next steps despite a production outage. The customer asks directly 'how long would that take' and 'should I expect to hear back,' but receives only vague assurances ('our team will look into,' 'when they get a chance,' 'will be in touch') without commitment, SLA, or specific follow-up mechanism. This leaves the customer in critical production impact with no concrete resolution path.
